heroSubtitle: Detailed application procedures for each Terra Revive application method. These method statements provide step-by-step guidance for contractors, operators, and reclamation specialists.

methods.title: Broadcast Application Method Statement
methods.description: Detailed procedure for applying Terra Revive pellets using broadcast spreaders. Includes equipment requirements, application rates, incorporation techniques, and safety protocols.
methods.equipment: Spreader truck, ATV spreader, or tractor-mounted spreader
methods.bestFor: Large wellsites, access roads, open areas

methods.title: Drill Incorporation Method Statement
methods.description: Step-by-step guide for applying Terra Revive pellets with seed drills. Covers drill calibration, seed row placement, and integration with seeding operations.
methods.equipment: Standard seed drill or air seeder
methods.bestFor: Sites with existing drill equipment, one-pass applications

methods.title: Hydroseeding Method Statement
methods.description: Complete hydroseeding protocol including mixing procedures, slurry preparation, application techniques, and equipment maintenance. Ensures even pellet distribution in hydroseed mix.
methods.equipment: Standard hydroseed equipment, no modifications required

methods.title: Drone Application Method Statement
methods.description: Emerging method for applying Terra Revive pellets using agricultural drones. Includes flight planning, spreader attachment setup, and application patterns for remote sites.
methods.bestFor: Remote sites, steep slopes, limited ground access

additionalInfo.title: Using method statements in tenders and reclamation plans
paragraphs: Method statements provide detailed application procedures that can be included in tender documents, reclamation plans, and regulatory submissions. Each method statement includes equipment requirements, safety protocols, application rates, and quality assurance procedures.
For site-specific method statements or custom application procedures, contact us to discuss your project requirements.
